observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "--- docker ps ---"; docker ps --filter name=openproject --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}'; echo "--- image digest ---"; docker inspect openproject --format '{{.Image}}' | xargs -I{} docker inspect {} --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' 2>&1; echo "--- recheck health ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "health=%{http_code} login=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/health_check
